translations.homeIntro: The all-in-one platform built for small and growing companies. Manage your team, data, and operations from a single, secure workspace — so you can focus on what matters most.
translations.homeSecureAccessBody: Get up and running in minutes. Invite your team, assign roles, and keep your organisation's data protected with enterprise-grade authentication — without the enterprise complexity.
translations.homeSpreadsheetBody: A powerful, familiar spreadsheet experience built right into the platform. View, edit, and collaborate on data in real time — no exports, no switching tools, no version conflicts.
translations.homeStorageBody: Store, organise, and share files with confidence. From contracts to spreadsheets, your documents are always at hand — securely hosted in the cloud and accessible from anywhere.
translations.homeTicketingBody: Stay on top of every request and issue. Create, assign, and track tickets through to resolution, giving your team full visibility and your customers faster responses.
translations.homeDataSchemaBody: Model your business your way. Define custom entities — customers, products, leads, and more — and build a data structure that reflects how your company actually works.
translations.homeAiAssistantBody: Work smarter with a built-in AI assistant that understands your business context. Ask questions, trigger actions, and navigate the platform using natural language — no training required.
translations.homeJobsBody: Automate the heavy lifting. Schedule and run data processing background tasks around the clock, so your reports are ready and your workflows keep moving — even while you sleep.
